_comment: Email content for the latest release. Update this each release as part of /release-update, then run send.mjs. Keep it to the highlights; this is an email, not the full changelog. British English, no em dashes, no emojis, no permanence words.
subject: InnerZero 0.2.0 is out
preheader: A High Contrast theme, drag and drop into chat, smarter setup, and the biggest reliability sweep since launch.
intro: Version 0.2.0 of InnerZero is now available. It is our largest update since launch, focused on reliability, honesty, accessibility, and privacy. Here are the highlights.

groups.label: New
items: High Contrast theme: a seventh free theme with a true-black background, plus WCAG AA text contrast across every theme and a readable minimum text size app-wide.
Drag and drop a document or screenshot straight onto the chat box to attach it, and copy any reply as clean plain text with the new Copy button.
Setup can now adopt models you already have installed instead of re-downloading them, and the window opens immediately with a progress line naming each startup step.

groups.label: Improved
items: The assistant makes fewer wrong tool detours, no longer returns raw encyclopedia dumps for simple questions, and engine errors are no longer stored into memory.
The Costs page now works across all eight time periods, with bring-your-own-key estimates refreshed to provider prices verified in August 2026.
Approvals are honest end to end: a failed action shows as a failure, and decided approval cards stay decided.

groups.label: Fixed
items: Chat, Settings, and the other main pages no longer paint stale content over the page you navigated to, and cleared chats stay cleared.
Marking a calendar event private now reliably removes the copy previously synced to Google.
Windows saves files to your real Documents folder even when OneDrive has redirected it, and macOS and Linux now see models in your existing Ollama store.
